description: Market overview for any filter: number of pools, total TVL, median, middle-half and TVL-weighted APY, grouped by chain (default), protocol or strategy, with the largest pool in each group. Rates in filters are fractions (0.05 = 5%).

groupBy.description: Break the statistics down by chain (default), protocol or strategy, or "none" for one overall row.

query.description: Pool filters (token, chain, protocol, strategy, APY, TVL, freshness), e.g. {"search":"usdc","strategies":["lending"]}. Defaults to pools with at least $100K TVL.

exitAvailableOnly.description: Only pools with evidence that withdrawals are available.

freshness.description: Data age rule. "retrieved" (default): retrieved within maxAgeMinutes. "observed": the source must state when it measured the rate. "any": include old quotes.

maxAgeMinutes.description: Maximum data age in minutes for the freshness rule (default 60). It can only shorten the window: each rate also expires after its own time-to-live (usually 60 minutes). To include older quotes use freshness "any".

maxApy.description: Maximum total APY. A fraction, not a percentage: 0.05 means 5%, 0.5 means 50%.

maxBaseApy.description: Maximum base APY. A fraction, not a percentage: 0.05 means 5%, 0.5 means 50%.

maxRewardApy.description: Maximum reward-token APY, e.g. 0 for pools paying no reward tokens. A fraction, not a percentage: 0.05 means 5%, 0.5 means 50%.

maxTvlUsd.description: Maximum total value locked in USD.

minApy.description: Minimum total APY. A fraction, not a percentage: 0.05 means 5%, 0.5 means 50%.

minBaseApy.description: Minimum base APY (organic yield, excluding reward tokens). A fraction, not a percentage: 0.05 means 5%, 0.5 means 50%.

minCoverage.description: Minimum share (0-100) of assessment checks with evidence.

minRewardApy.description: Minimum reward-token APY. A fraction, not a percentage: 0.05 means 5%, 0.5 means 50%.

minScore.description: Minimum experimental assessment score 0-100. Few pools have reviewed evidence, so this usually returns nothing.

minTvlUsd.description: Minimum total value locked in USD. Defaults to 100,000 on this server; pass 0 to include tiny pools.

protocols.description: Protocol slugs (case-insensitive exact match), e.g. ["aave-v3","morpho-blue","compound-v3"]. Use search for partial names.

providers.description: Data feed: "pool-feed" (lending, liquidity and staking pools) or "vault-feed" (auto-compounding vaults).

search.description: Words that must all appear in the pool symbol, protocol, chain, market label or token address, e.g. "usdc", "steth", "aave usdt".

singleAssetOnly.description: Only single-asset pools (no LP pairs, so no impermanent loss from a pair).

sort.description: Sort field. Default "tvl" (largest pools first); use "apy" for the highest quoted APY first.

stablecoinOnly.description: Only pools whose assets are all recognised stablecoins (single or pairs). Labels only; says nothing about peg safety.

stablecoinPairOnly.description: Only pools pairing two or more recognised stablecoins, e.g. USDC-USDT.

strategies.description: Pool type: lending markets, vaults, liquidity (DEX LP) pools or staking.

topGroups.description: How many groups to return, largest TVL first (default 10).

name: summarize_yields
title: Summarize yields across a market
